coverage_gaps: No citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available for systematic forward and backward citation expansion; linkage must rely on PubMed metadata and explicit identifiers.
No non-US regulator route is available, so EMA and other jurisdictional actions cannot be systematically compared with FDA actions.
No Embase or other subscription subject index is available, which may reduce retrieval of conference abstracts and non-MEDLINE observational evidence.
No direct claims, electronic-health-record, or pharmacovigilance database route is available; qualifying real-world evidence is limited to studies indexed in PubMed.
ClinicalTrials.gov historical-version retrieval may be incomplete through the available route, limiting reconstruction of every registry amendment and posting date.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence first made public after 2024-12-31, while retaining an earlier record only when its pre-cutoff version is independently verifiable.
Animal, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, efficacy-only, or mechanistic reports without decision-relevant clinical safety data.
Studies confined to non-rheumatoid indications unless they directly inform an FDA action applied to marketed rheumatoid-arthritis use.
JAK-inhibitor class discussions that provide no separable tofacitinib evidence and no direct account of an FDA action affecting tofacitinib.
Narrative summaries, news reports, or secondary commentary when the underlying registry record, primary study, or FDA document is available.
Duplicate publications lacking additional outcomes, follow-up, subgroup information, or integrity status; identifier links remain preserved during deduplication.
Retracted evidence as affirmative support for a safety conclusion; retain the bibliographic record solely to document retraction status and downstream impact.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31; ambiguous indexing dates require verification of online-first, issue, registry-update, or FDA effective dates.

The ClinicalTrials.gov record for the pivotal postauthorization study and publications or FDA actions that can be linked by NCT number, sponsor study identifier, title, authorship, or explicit trial description.

Randomized, extension, registry, cohort, claims, meta-analytic, or regulatory evidence that reports or materially interprets cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcomes for marketed tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis.
Evidence reporting absolute event counts or rates, relative estimates, confidence intervals, dose information, comparator definition, follow-up, or clinically relevant risk modifiers.
Corrections, errata, expressions of concern, retraction notices, and replacement versions associated with any included pivotal or influential record.
FDA safety communications, reviews, approval materials, and dated labeling actions that directly address tofacitinib or use the pivotal trial to impose class-relevant restrictions.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and capture official title, sponsor identifiers, enrollment, eligibility, arms, outcomes, dates, and result-posting history.
Recover publications explicitly linked to the pivotal study and verify registry-to-publication identifiers.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "A3921133"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Recover FDA materials that identify or describe the required postmarketing safety trial.
Discover peer-reviewed rheumatoid-arthritis safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcome domains.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify registered tofacitinib rheumatoid-arthritis studies with safety outcomes and detect related or predecessor records.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch] "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch] tofacitinib AND (safety OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Discover FDA safety communications, reviews, labeling revisions, and prescribing-information changes addressing the four outcome domains.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis cardiovascular cancer thrombosis death boxed warning label

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary comparative publication and its trial identity, population, comparator, doses, follow-up, and principal estimates.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND ("tumor necrosis factor inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR TNFi[Title/Abstract]) AND (Ytterberg[Author] OR "cardiovascular and cancer risk"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve primary and secondary analyses that qualify cardiovascular and malignancy findings, including risk-factor and subtype analyses.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses and reports addressing venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and mortality.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm registry-specified outcomes and posted results relevant to the assessed safety signals.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId]NCT02092467 AND (AREA[OutcomeMeasure]cardiovascular OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure]malignancy OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure]thrombosis OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure]death)

queries.purpose: Locate the final FDA safety conclusion and establish announcement dates, affected products, population restrictions, and required warning changes.
queries.query: site:fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability tofacitinib Xeljanz serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death final results

queries.purpose: Trace the safety findings into dated US prescribing information and boxed-warning language.
queries.query: site:accessdata.fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz prescribing information boxed warning thrombosis malignancy mortality major adverse cardiovascular events

queries.purpose: Find external observational evidence that may corroborate, qualify, or conflict with the risk-enriched randomized trial.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve subgroup and risk-stratification analyses needed to assess generalizability to marketed use.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (age[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular risk"[Title/Abstract] OR subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Detect integrity notices and deliberately seek null or conflicting interpretations that could change evidence handling.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (correction[Publication Type] OR retracted publication[Publication Type] OR retraction of publication[Publication Type] OR erratum[Title] OR retract*[Title/Abstract] OR "expression of concern"[Title/Abstract])) OR ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (no association[Title/Abstract] OR no increase[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Capture late publications and integrity updates through the fixed assessment cutoff.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract])) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title/Abstract] OR retraction[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Safety PECO as of 2024-12-31: adults with rheumatoid arthritis, emphasizing the cardiovascular-risk-enriched population of the pivotal postauthorization study; marketed tofacitinib at evaluated doses as exposure; tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and relevant background rates as comparators; major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, all-cause and cause-specific mortality as outcomes; link the study's registry identity, protocol identifiers, primary publication, subsequent qualifying or conflicting evidence, FDA communications and labeling actions, and correction, expression-of-concern, or retraction status.
stop_rules: Complete all 16 planned query events across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and FDA regulatory routes, recording exact query, execution time, requested cutoff, and result count.

Do not stop until NCT02092467, sponsor identifier A3921133, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, and the FDA final safety action are recovered and cross-linked, or their absence is explicitly escalated.

Continue terminology expansion when any anchor is missed, including trial identifiers, brand names, comparator aliases, outcome aliases, and publication-author clues, without exceeding the 16-event budget.
Stop expansion after two consecutive completed expansion or challenge searches add no new decision-relevant primary record, linked analysis, regulatory action, or evidence-integrity notice.

Stop when cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have screened pivotal evidence plus any located qualifying or conflicting evidence, and every influential included publication has a resolved correction or retraction check.
If the 16-query budget is exhausted before anchor or outcome coverage is complete, terminate retrieval, mark the affected domain as unresolved, and report the specific route and evidence gap.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval whenever provider date semantics are ambiguous, and preserve excluded post-cutoff updates for a future update wave without using them in this assessment.
